newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi stocks down on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Delhi stocks down on political uncertainty.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange drifted lower in afternoon trade on Monday on selling by foreign investors and speculators linked to a fluid political situtation, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index was 6.30 points lower at 879.64 at 1.00 p.m. (0730 GMT).
"The market's behaviour has been confusing as it has ignored the favourable developments on the political front," said R.S. Jolly of brokers H.S. Lakhotia and Company.

Traders said the market was closely following the developments in Bihar where newly-installed chief minister Rabri Devi, wife of former chief minister Laloo Prasad Yadav, was seeking a vote of confidence in the state assembly.

Yadav has been criticised by leaders of India's ruling United Front coalition for his moves to field his wife after he resigned on Friday, four weeks after being indicted in a $280 million scandal involving the alleged embezzlement of state funds. He says he is innocent.
ITC dropped 20.00 rupees on heavy selling by speculators and foreign investors, brokers said.
State Bank of India slipped 4.30 rupees to 319.40.
